mapper.select: select a.id as id, a.email as email, a.mobilephone as mobilephone, a.username as username, a.personalized_signature as personalizedSignature, a.enable as enable, a.avatar_url as avatar, (select group_concat(b.name) as rol from time_doser.acl_user_role c left join time_doser.acl_role b on c.role_id = b.id where c.user_id = a.id) as authoritiesString from time_doser.base_user a where a.id = #{id}
